# St. Catharines

> St. Catharines is the official municipal government portal providing citizens and businesses with online services, permits, licenses, and community engagement tools.

The City of St. Catharines offers comprehensive digital services through its main website and specialized portals (mySTC, build.stcatharines.ca, webforms) for permit applications, tax management, and civic issue reporting. The city prioritizes accessibility and community engagement through multiple channels including social media, EngageSTC, and dedicated support services.

## Key Topics

- Building Permits
- Permit Applications
- Municipal Services
- Business Licensing
- Development Applications
- Ontario Building Code
- Planning and Building Services
- mySTC Portal
- Accessibility Services
- Community Engagement
- Home Renovation
- Construction Projects
- City of St. Catharines
- Online Applications
- Civic Issue Reporting

## Core Services & Portals

- [St. Catharines Homepage](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/index.aspx): Main city homepage with news, events, and community engagement.
- [mySTC Portal](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/news-notices-and-updates/mystc-portal.aspx): Citizen portal for tax, billing, and municipal service management.
- [Online Building Applications](https://build.stcatharines.ca): Online portal for permits, property search, and building department applications.
- [Report an Issue](https://webforms.stcatharines.ca/Report-an-Issue): Form to report civic issues, complaints, bylaw violations, and maintenance.

## Building & Construction Permits

- [Building Permits Overview](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/building-and-renovating/building-permits.aspx): Building permit process, eligibility, and Ontario Building Code compliance.
- [Applying for a Building Permit](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/building-and-renovating/applying-for-a-building-permit.aspx): Step-by-step guide to apply for building permits for construction projects.
- [Do I Need a Building Permit?](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/building-and-renovating/do-i-need-a-building-permit.aspx): Determine if building permit required for renovation and construction.
- [Building Inspections](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/building-and-renovating/inspections.aspx): Building, sewer, and fire inspections for safety and code compliance.
- [Issued Permits Database](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/building-and-renovating/issued-permits.aspx): Searchable database of previously issued building permits.
- [Heritage Permits](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/building-and-renovating/heritage-permits.aspx): Heritage permit requirements for designated properties and districts.

## Licenses & Permits

- [Applications, Licences and Permits](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/applications-licences-and-permits/applications-licences-and-permits.aspx): Overview of available permits and licenses with application procedures.
- [Business Licences](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/business-and-economic-development/business-licences.aspx): Business license application and renewal process for St. Catharines.
- [Liquor Licences](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/business-and-economic-development/liquor-licences.aspx): Liquor license application through AGCO for businesses and patios.
- [Dog Licences](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/by-laws-and-animal-services/dog-licences.aspx): Dog license purchase and pet ownership requirements and regulations.
- [Lottery and Gaming Licences](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/applications-licences-and-permits/lottery-and-gaming-licences.aspx): Lottery and gaming license application for raffles and events.

## Planning & Development

- [Development Applications](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/planning-and-development/development-applications.aspx): Development applications for zoning, subdivisions, and site plans.

## Special Permits & Programs

- [Burn Permits](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/fire-and-emergency-services/burn-permits.aspx): Burn permit requirements for agricultural and non-agricultural fires.
- [Food Trucks and Mobile Vending Carts](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/recreation-and-leisure/vendors-and-food-trucks.aspx): Application process for food truck and mobile vending cart permits.
- [Community and Cultural Displays Program](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/applications-licences-and-permits/community-and-cultural-displays-program.aspx): Permit application for community and cultural displays on city property.

## Community Support & Accessibility

- [Accessibility Services](https://www.stcatharines.ca/en/community-services-and-supports/accessibility.aspx): City accessibility services, policies, and barrier removal initiatives.
